newsitem.title: DUBAI: Yemen's Iryani in Riyadh for border talks.
newsitem.headline: Yemen's Iryani in Riyadh for border talks.

text.p: Yemen's Deputy Prime Minister and Foreign Minister Abdul-Karim al-Iryani arrived in Riyadh on Saturday for border talks with Saudi Officials, the official Saudi Press Agency (SPA) said.
SPA said Iryani held talks with Saudi Interior Minister Prince Nayef bin Abdul-Aziz aimed at following up on border talks between the neighbouring states.
Yemen and Saudi Arabia had several minor clashes in a potentially oil-and gas-rich border area before they signed a memorandum of understanding last year to resolve the 60-year-old dispute.
